en: A black‑and‑white image showing a grand neo‑Baroque parliamentary or governmental building with a long façade of tall Corinthian columns, elaborate sculptural groups along the roofline, and two corner towers. A central portico with a pediment and statues is approached by several arched entrances. In front is an open square or broad street with a few pedestrians and a small landscaped garden area. The overall look is that of an early 20th‑century architectural photograph commonly used on postcards.
